insight: Built at IBM Research Zurich and donated to the LF AI & Data Foundation in April 2025.
name: Docling
tagline: Open-source toolkit that turns documents into AI-ready Markdown and JSON.
description: A document-processing toolkit that converts PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, HTML, images, and audio into clean Markdown or JSON for LLM and RAG pipelines. It does advanced PDF understanding — page layout, reading order, table structure, and OCR for scans — and ships a hybrid chunker plus native LangChain and LlamaIndex integrations. Small enough to run on a laptop via a Python API or CLI; MIT-licensed and community-governed.
edge: Open-source AI layout detection that preserves reading order and table structure — self-hostable, no API bills.
pros: IBM Research origin, now LF AI project
cons: Lower accuracy than top hosted parsers
No managed cloud / SLA out of the box
Setup and tuning effort vs. an API

references.title: Docling vs LlamaParse vs Unstructured vs Reducto: Document Parser Comparison
